name: jira_worklog_add
description: Adds a worklog entry to an issue (POST /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/worklog)

issue_key.description: The ID or key of the issue the worklog is added to, for example CRM-21.

time_spent.description: The time spent, as days, hours, and minutes in Jira duration format, for example 3h 30m.

time_spent_seconds.description: The time spent in seconds, for example 12600 for 3h 30m.

comment.description: A comment describing the work done.

started.description: The datetime the work began, for example 2026-08-07T09:30:00.000-0400.

author.description: The display name to record as the worklog author.

author_email.description: The email address of the worklog author.
